title: Thai Larb Chicken Salad
description: A spicy and sour salad from Thailand, made with crispy fried chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy dressing.
instructions: 1. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the chicken. Cook until browned and cooked through.
3. In a blender or food processor, combine the fish sauce, chili, larb spice mix, chicken broth, and a squeeze of lime juice.
4. In a large bowl, combine the cooked chicken, crisp lettuce, crisp shallots, and crisp mint.
5. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
6. Serve immediately and garnish with additional herbs if desired.
